cohort: Mothers who gave birth at the obstetrics and gynecology department of LEKMA Hospital in Ghana.
finding: The prevalence of cesarean section was 40.6%, higher than the WHO recommended rate, and was associated with maternal age, parity, gestational age, and educational status.
mod_finding: Increased gestational age and parity decreased the risk of cesarean section, while increased maternal age and higher educational status increased the risk.
